title: Superpowers vs GSD
summary: Superpowers centers a design-to-plan-to-execution skill sequence. GSD centers a persistent project ledger and phased roadmap that later agent sessions resume.

title: GitHub Spec Kit vs Kiro Specs
summary: Spec Kit produced a wide repository artifact tree with constitution checks and interface contracts. Kiro documents a tighter requirements-design-tasks chain, shown here only as a clearly labeled manual example.

title: Matt Pocock's skills vs BMad Method
summary: Matt Pocock's flow uses a durable spec as the bridge to tracker tickets. BMad offers a much larger menu of role-based workflows plus a compact express technical-spec path.
